description:
Open any 3D file and see dimensions, inspection results, and manufacturing cost in one view. No CAD required.

Creallo Atlas opens STEP, STL and 10 other 3D formats without a CAD licence.

Measure distances, diameters, wall thickness and clearances. Inspect meshes for
holes, non-manifold edges and thin walls that will fail in production, and repair
the light ones in place. Ask Creallo for an indicative manufacturing cost for the
part on screen.

Your design files stay on your computer while you view, measure and inspect them.
A file is uploaded only when you press Share to create a link.
